text:
maria: Quick heads-up — ran a cross-GPU attention benchmark sweep and hit a weird perf regression on H100/L40S for long sequences when batch >= 8. A100 seems fine.

maria: benchmark gist: https://short.link/attn-bench-2148 (csv + flamegraphs)

maria: command used:
```
./run_attn_bench --model=gpt2-5b --seq-lens=512,1024,2048,4096 --batches=1,4,8,16 --gpu=h100,l40s,a100 --kernel-policy=auto --kv-mode=paged
```

devon: ugh. what does the perf curve look like? tail latency or throughput? :thinking:

maria: main symptom = throughput drop ~25-35% at seq>=2048 for batch 8/16 on h100/l40s. tail and p50 both affected. fallback logs show selector switching from fused_paged -> paged_prefetch variant around those combos.

lee: can you paste the selector trace? I want to see the decision path (prefetch window / seq threshold).

maria: selector snippet:
```
[selector] seq=4096 batch=8 hw=h100 -> try(fused_attn_v2) -> OOM? no -> run_time_estimate=fused:12.1ms paged_prefetch:9.3ms -> choose(paged_prefetch)
```

maria: but paged_prefetch perf regressed vs earlier runs (same binary) — profiler shows increased memcpy and stall cycles in the prefetch path.

austin: did the kernel build change? any new alignment/ldg changes for prefetch?

maria: binary is identical SHA. We did push a scheduler tweak (dynamic-batch-window) earlier this week — could affect batch packing and alignment.

kevin: perf-bot just posted the nvprof summary for a failing run: https://artifacts/2148001234/nvprof.html

perf-bot: [auto] nvprof top 5 kernels: memcpy.h2d (42%), prefetch_loader (28%), attention_page_handler (15%), fused_attn_kernel (8%), others (7%)

lee: memcpy.h2d that high is suspicious — maybe prefetch is crying for too many small chunk copies. Are we splitting into many tiny pages?

maria: yes, page size = 64KB with prefetch window=4 by default. When batch packs to >=8 we end up issuing ~N small copies per step.

devon: can we try increasing page size or turning prefetch window down? also compare with kvcache disabled to confirm source.

maria: tried: page_size=256KB -> reduced memcpy overhead but latency still ~10% worse than baseline. Disabling prefetch entirely restores expected throughput.

lee: ok that points to prefetch path regression. Two quick hypotheses: 1) deadline-based throttling in our memcpy layer kicking in under concurrent copies, 2) new scheduler changed request packing so copies overlap poorly with compute.

austin: suggestion: run single-GPU micro-run with --trace-cuda and set prefetch_window=1, page_size=256KB, and instrument CQ timings. I'll try repro on L40S.

maria: dropping a small flamegraph excerpt inline: 
<flamegraph: https://artifacts/2148001234/flamegraph.svg>

maria: note the big red block around prefetch_loader during token emission phase.

kevin: can we mitigate by temporarily biasing selector to prefer fused_attn_v2 for these (seq>=2048,batch>=8,hw in [h100,l40s]) while we root cause? we can A/B guard it.

devon: +1 for temporary selector bias. open an issue/rollout ticket and feature flag it so we don't break production.

maria: created ENGR-4571 with repro steps and artifacts. PR to add selector bias as rollout flag: https://git/repo/pull/6821

lee: I'll own the bisect of prefetch_loader changes. starting with commit range: ab12..cd34. will post findings.

austin: repro attempt on L40S: confirming memcpy spike. sending nvprof and trace. will dump cupti timestamps.

maria: thanks all. follow-ups:
- lee to bisect prefetch_loader changes (ETA tomorrow)
- austin to validate selector bias mitigates perf in canary (ETA today)
- devon/kevin to stage feature-flag rollout plan

maria: if anyone has quick ideas about memcpy aggregation or async copy heuristics, drop them here. saved me a lot when you did that last time. :pray:

kevin: maybe try batching H2D copies into a single pinned-buffer copy path (we used that in the paging PoC). low effort toggle in runtime.

devon: noting that this only reproduces with real KV-sized contexts (we used synthetic random tensors earlier which missed the packing behavior). protip: use real prompt traces for microbench.

maria: agreed. attaching a small real workload sample for repro: https://artifacts/2148001234/sample-prompts.json

lee: update: bisect points to commit cd12f7 -> change in prefetch split logic. sending a minimal repro and a fix proposal.

maria: awesome. once we have a patch, let's run full sweep across a100/h100/l40s and add regression test to perf CI.

kevin: noted. I'll add a nightly job for seqLens=[1024,2048,4096] batch=[8,16] across all GPUs to catch this early.

maria: closing loop here, will post results in thread when we have a PR and canary numbers. thanks! :raised_hands:
